scope: Preliminary complete flushing, sodium-hypochlorite disinfection, sampling and handover of an already installed potable-water pipeline after pressure testing. Pipeline volume, flushing flow and water, disinfectant, temporary connections, consumables, labor, equipment, laboratory work, procurement balance and disposal logistics are calculated from eight ordinary primary facts and a visible editable engineering profile.
calculatedScope: pipeline internal volume and required flushing flow
flushing, disinfection-fill and total water demand
active chlorine and sodium-hypochlorite solution demand
temporary fill, injection, drain and sampling connections
hoses, fittings, valves, backflow prevention, supports and consumables
flushing pumps, dosing equipment and monitoring instruments
field chlorine and turbidity checks, laboratory samples and analyses
PPE, spill response, labor, equipment-hours, records and logistics
hypochlorite procurement need, packages, ordered quantity and remainder
conditionalProjectFacts: off-site collection and disposal of flushing water
excludedScope: pipeline construction, excavation, bedding, pipe supply, valves, chambers and hydrants
hydrostatic pressure testing and leak repair
chlorination-station construction, contact reservoirs and permanent treatment equipment
gas chlorine, on-site electrochlorination and unconfirmed discharge routes
prices or manufacturer performance not supplied by a confirmed source
truthBoundary: This is a visible preliminary execution profile, not an approved universal method statement or sanitary instruction. Every profile assumption remains editable and requires confirmation by the project, operator, laboratory and environmental discharge authority. Derived final quantities are never ordinary questionnaire inputs.
